headline: Technical Support Specialist | Flutter Developer | Customer Service Professional
summary: A versatile and results-driven professional with over four years of combined experience in technical support, mobile application development, customer service, administrative operations, graphic design, and virtual assistance. Skilled in troubleshooting technical issues, developing mobile applications, managing customer relationships, and supporting business operations. Proficient in Flutter, Dart, Firebase, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace. Demonstrates strong communication, problem-solving, multitasking, and organisational abilities.

experiences.description:
- Resolved an average of 25–35 technical support requests weekly, covering software issues, account access, password resets, and system troubleshooting.
- Reduced recurring support requests by approximately 20% by creating simple troubleshooting guides and instructional videos.
- Maintained documentation for technical incidents, ensuring accurate tracking and follow-up on unresolved issues.
- Supported approximately 50 employees with day-to-day technical challenges.
- Collaborated with internal teams to resolve technical issues within agreed service timelines.

- Maintained and updated employee records for approximately 100 employees, including names, email addresses, contract types, job roles, and assigned work equipment.
- Resolved missing employee information and account documentation within 24 hours of notification.
- Investigated payroll discrepancies affecting employees and coordinated with the finance team to resolve outstanding payments.
- Successfully resolved two employee payment documentation issues within 72 hours, with one additional case completed the following Monday due to pending finance approval.
- Improved record-keeping accuracy through consistent documentation and regular employee information updates.

- Handled approximately 40–50 customer enquiries daily through telephone calls, emails, and messaging platforms.
- Maintained a customer satisfaction rating of approximately 90% through effective communication and timely issue resolution.
- Resolved approximately 80% of customer complaints at first contact.
- Followed up with customers to ensure outstanding complaints were addressed.
- Documented customer interactions and escalated complex cases to the appropriate departments.

- Designed approximately 30–40 graphics monthly for social media campaigns, promotional materials, and business advertisements.
- Managed daily administrative activities, including email correspondence, scheduling, and document organisation.
- Created branded visual content that maintained consistency across digital marketing platforms.
- Conducted online research and prepared organised reports to support business decisions.
- Assisted with social media content planning and customer engagement.

- Made approximately 50–70 outbound calls daily to prospective customers.
- Identified and qualified potential leads based on customer needs and product suitability.
- Maintained accurate prospect databases and documented call outcomes.
- Scheduled follow-up conversations with interested prospects to improve conversion opportunities.
- Handled customer objections professionally and communicated product benefits effectively.
